notes.title: Patch v1.0e is now available
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24319119/ce1748606eed7de8d638417197c397bd70082a19.png[/img]

[h1]
WARNING: This is an experimental build only can be stabilized in one month.
[/h1]
Please report your bugs here -->
http://steamcommunity.com/app/454070/discussions/0/144512753466334643/

[b]Here is the patch details[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed: Owned npcs acts criminal after logout
[*]Fixed: Resurrection is not working
[*]New balance: (Mover Type) Spell moving speed is not affected by abilities (atk, mgc, dfs)
[*]New balance: Summon spells needs that consumable: Soul Gem
[*]New Balance: Abilites (Attack, Defence, Magic) has lesser role on spell effect calculation
[*]New Balance: Bless, Curse, Burning Foots, Frost Storm, Ice Spike, Damage Reflection, Protection, Summon Citizen, Summon Evil, Summon Monk and Summon Guard skills wil get lesser (/3) effect by users abilites (Attack, Defence, Magic)
[*]Fixed: Owned npcs not following the player after teleport
[*]Renewed some of ui elements
[*]Fixed: No legs while wearing Starting pants (Male & Skeleton)
[*]Fixed: Bugged animation while polymorphed
[*]Fixed: Owned npcs not following the player after teleport
[*]Renewed damage point ui method
[*]Gambling on smith is optimized.
[*]Quest names will shown on interact tooltip
[*]Fixed: Bracelet/Scroll item conflict on client tooltip
[*]Interactions will be made by double click instead of Space bar
[*]Newbie players won't loss item durability when they die.
[*]Starting quest bug. Skeleton quest is the starting quest now.
[*]Fixed: potion particles
[*]Renewed notification list
[*]Renewed vendor item list
[*]New ray spell: Lightning
[*]Optimized(mostly decreased) item values, drop rates and vendor prices.
[*]Weapon weight no longer affect the weapon damage. It's all about 'attack' of the weapon now.
[*]Weapon heaviness added. Higher weapon heaviness means slower attacks.
[*]Fixed: Teleporting back after resurrection
[*]Players can swim now.
[*]Players can go through on water with these mounts:
[list]
[*]Evil Eye
[*]Dragon Turtle
[*]Yellow Manticore
[*]Orange Manticore
[*]Fire Manticore
[*]Dark Manticore
[*]Flying Soul Eater
[*]Flame Dragon
[*]and of course Wooden Boat
[/list]
[*]Players can go through on water while polymorphed with these polymorphs:
[list]
[*]Giant Bat
[*]Dragon
[*]Flame Dragon
[*]Humppack
[*]Ice Dragon
[*]Flying Soul Eater
[*]Water Elemental
[*]Dragon Turtle
[*]Evil Eye Monster
[*]Yellow Manticore
[*]Orange Manticore
[*]Fire Manticore
[*]Dark Manticore
[/list]

[*]Removed: Zombie
[*]Added: Skeleton Warrior & Skeleton Mage
[*]Added: New footsteps controller & sounds & particles
[*]New player animations!
[*]A new simple land, includes high level enemies
[*]Fixed: Summoned monsters is not affected by the level of the casted spell
[*]Added: Agent status tags (Owner: xx, (Boss) etc.)
[*]Fixed: Cannot move anymore after getting a powerful stun effect
[*]Fixed: Summon Guard particle shader
[*]Fixed: Protection particle shader
[*]Fixed: Starting game failed
[/list]

notes.title: Patch v1.0d Details, Better Gameplay
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24319119/8bdeb3437d31391c7258d75e1f64a03865424855.jpg[/img]

Hello!
I've made some major changes & new features listed below.
This patch (1.0d) will be released at 06 January 2017 Friday.

[list]
[*]New movement synchronization algorithm, NO LAG even on high latency.
[*]New aiming algorithm, the smoothest aiming ever.
[*]Tamed creatures won't be disappear anymore after log out. They will stay in the world straggling until you login again.
[*]New spell: 'Release' to release owned creatures.
[*]Visual bugs fixed on gargoyle, fire elemental and water elemental.
[*]Fixed: Satan place spawn time.
[*]Shrink spells will hit the target by the power of the spell now to increase the change to shrink after trying & trying. Now it is useful :)
[*]Fixed: Nightmare and Mustang cannot be shrinked
[*]Fixed: Armored horse won't spawn
[*]Added Spell Type: Ray spell. Aim the ray continously after casting. 
[*]First aim spell: Dragon breath. The legends are true, if you have a flame dragon. A lot more aim spell will come in time.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Us4xyLYIRaE
[*]Fixed: Corrupted shrink potions
[/list]
See you at the Patch 1.0d,
Eren

notes.title: Christmas Patch 1.0b
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24319119/cf23105b91005289afe316186bda120e17d2129f.png[/img]

Hello folks!
The patch contains a lot of game fixes, performance impovements and of course [b]Santa![/b]

Patch 1.0b will be available at [h1]20 December 2016[/h1]
You will able to find Santa everywhere until 2017. His spawn rate is very high as a zombie.
Kill him and earn a lot of xp and loot!

Also when I was doing some balancing to the game, I've decided the game is very hard to gain experience points and increasing your skills. So with this patch, earning levels will be very easy until forever! 

Sincerely,
Eren

notes.title: Patch v1.0a Released
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24319119/a3bf114562cc11c3adfe4526cf0bf60213d03977.png[/img]

[list]
[*]New spell type Dispel, clear the all buffs & the curses of the target. Dispel will also remove walls created by spell.
[*]New spell type Morph, morph your target (Currently only Pig is available :))
[*]Rides won't be dropped from monsters anymore.
[*]Some animals will run from threads now.

[*]Spell effect time will be effected by spell level now.
[*]Spell speed will be effected by spell level now.
[*]Added ride: Soul Eater.
[*]New land: Zornia
[*]Added powerful monster: Flame Dragon (Rideable)
[*]Added Item: Curse Wand (needed for casting Morph spells)
[*]Random treasure spawns, now you can find treasures on the map. Hit & destroy them and earn the great rewards!
[*]New water shader
[/list]

notes.title: Important Patch 0.5a Information: The wiping all characters.
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.boundel.com/images/steam/steaminfo.jpg[/img]

Hi, [b]
With the new patch, the world will be changed.
So, all of your characters will be wiped.[/b]

You will get gold coins in your bank box with this formula.
Level of the most leveled character in your account * 1000
[i]For example:
If you have 30 level character as most leveled in your account, you will have 30.000 gold in your bank box.[/i]
 
[u]You will also get a unique item, it cannot be dropped from monsters.[/u]
[h1]
The patch 0.5a will be available at the weekend. [/h1]

Cheers!
Eren

notes.title: Patch 0.4c is available!
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.boundel.com/images/steam/0.4c.jpg[/img]


[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Cloak item type added with cloth physics.
[*]Looting from players disabled. When a player dies, only gold coins in their inventory will be dropped. Gold coins on the bank box is safe.
[*]Last death position icon added.
[*]New loot and treasure algoritm. More accurate items, a lot of rares!
[*]New quality option: Ultra high
[*].stuck feature. Type '.stuck' on chat if you stucked at a position.
[*]New spell type: 'World' with two spells yet. Wall of Stone & Wall of Fire.
[*]Wall of Stone, creates walls to cover.
[*]Wall of Fire, a line of fire hits continuously.
[*]Newbie players will able to loot/drop every item.
[*]More balanced spells.
[*]x2 experience at night.
[/list]

Next patch will be available before July.
It will be a quite big patch.

Cheers,
Eren

notes.title: About the incoming patch & IMPORTANT NOTIFICATION ABOUT FULL LOOT PvP
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.boundel.com/images/steam/04cAnnounce.jpg[/img]

Hi, I'm working on the new patch, the patch make the game well balanced & ofcourse some graphical improvements are coming.

[b]With the new patch, full loot pvp will be disabled permanently. It's nothing except pain for me and players.[/b]
Of course you will still able to fight with players, but only for gold coins.

[list]
[*]New item type: Cloaks, capes (With realistic cloth physics)
[*]A lot of bug fixes.
[*]Stuck feature, if you stucked somewhere you will able to use this option to get out. (.stuck)
[*]New spell type: 'World' with two spells yet. Wall of Stone & Wall of Fire.
[*]Newbie players will able to loot.
[*]More balanced spells.[/list]

I will update here some screens until the patch comes.

Cheers,
Eren

notes.notes:

Please make sure the automatic update is opened for Boundel (default)

________________________________________________________
Update Log (07 May 2015) 

/* Version 0.1c */

- Shadows option added to options.
- Movement lag fixed. Now it's smooth.
- Divine Metal Chest & Divine Pants (items) bug fixed.
- New chat input system added.
- Some new places & spawns added.
- Shops are not open at night anymore.
- Vision bug on the lowest graphics quality fixed.
- Price of the smiths has been decreased to Rate*3 from Rate*5
- Game loading time has been decreased by %200
- Effecting by curse spell was dropping your items, fixed.
- Connection improvements on server side.

Known Bug: Slowing at higher movement speeds.
Known Bug: Player can walk into the colliders but actually it's not on the server. Please keep distance with colliders :) I'm trying to fix it with a smart solution.

[b]You lose the database on your local server with this update. Sorry for that. But this will never happened again.[/b]
